original.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 upgrades the http-wasm host to v0.6.0 to support clients using v0.4.0.

exposure.needed: whether the environment loads Traefik WASM plugins built on http-wasm, and which http-wasm guest version they use; the evidence names no configuration key, flag or resource kind for this

corrected.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 upgrades its http-wasm host to v0.6.0 to support plugin clients using http-wasm v0.4.0. Environments are exposed only if they run http-wasm (WASM) plugins, which the evidence does not tie to any static configuration predicate.

decision.reason: [ev-bfb9c0ed4d28] says only that the http-wasm host used for plugins was upgraded to v0.6.0 so that it supports clients (guests) using v0.4.0. Nothing in it names a Kubernetes kind called "Plugin". The proposed gvk-in-use{kind: Plugin}, which has no group, is therefore unsupported: it could flag unrelated resources and miss environments that are exposed. Exposure depends on whether the environment runs WASM plugins built against http-wasm and which guest version they use. The evidence gives no configuration predicate for that, so the condition should be undecidable.
